title: AirAsia Group completes name change from AirAsia X
desc: KUALA LUMPUR: AirAsia Group Bhd has completed its name change from AirAsia X Bhd to AirAsia Group Bhd, effective July 2.

desc: President Cyril Ramaphosa has extended the deadline for the Madlanga Commission to hand in its final report by two and a half months – because, without this extension, it would have “to leave large parts of its work unfinished”.

title: Friday is not a holiday: What you need to know about the June 10-11 national cleaning days
desc: Friday is not a public holiday despite the nationwide closure of markets and shops for Ghana's National General Cleaning Days. Government says the exercise aims to clear drains, disinfect flood-affected areas and reduce the risk of further flooding and disease outbreaks.
